mapper.sql: p.id, p.name, p.category, p.participants, p.leader_id, p.customer_name, p.customer_contact, p.start_time, p.status, p.process_instance_id, p.final_status, p.tenant_id, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.delflag

p.id, p.name, p.category, p.participants, p.leader_id, p.customer_name, p.customer_contact, p.start_time, p.status, p.process_instance_id, p.final_status, p.tenant_id, p.created_by, p.updated_by, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.delflag, e.name as leader_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_detail pd WHERE pd.project_id = p.id AND pd.delflag = 0) as participant_count, DATEDIFF(NOW(), p.start_time) as days_running
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM project p LEFT JOIN employee e ON p.leader_id = e.id AND e.delflag = 0 WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.delflag = 0

SELECT
FROM project p WHERE p.leader_id = #{leaderId} AND p.delflag = 0 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT DISTINCT
FROM project p INNER JOIN project_detail pd ON p.id = pd.project_id WHERE pd.participant_id = #{participantId} AND p.delflag = 0 AND pd.delflag = 0 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT
FROM project p WHERE p.status = #{status} AND p.delflag = 0 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT
FROM project p WHERE p.category = #{category} AND p.delflag = 0 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'init' THEN 1 END) as init_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'running' THEN 1 END) as running_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'closed' THEN 1 END) as closed_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN final_status = 'approved' THEN 1 END) as approved_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN final_status = 'rejected' THEN 1 END) as rejected_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(created_at) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END) as today_created, COUNT(CASE WHEN YEARWEEK(created_at) = YEARWEEK(NOW()) THEN 1 END) as week_created, COUNT(CASE WHEN YEAR(created_at) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(created_at) = MONTH(NOW()) THEN 1 END) as month_created FROM project WHERE delflag = 0

SELECT
FROM project p WHERE p.start_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND p.delflag = 0 ORDER BY p.start_time DESC

SELECT
FROM project p LEFT JOIN employee e ON p.leader_id = e.id AND e.delflag = 0 WHERE p.status = 'running' AND p.delflag = 0 AND DATEDIFF(NOW(), p.start_time) >= (#{days} - 7) ORDER BY p.start_time ASC
